explanatory_strength.rationale: Owner-earnings story is understandable: high-performance silicon converting to $3.37/sh free cash flow after modest capex, with reinvestment into Data Center AI and EPYC. Franchise quality is rising with mix; the open question is price paid for that quality.

evidence_sufficiency.rationale: FY2025 OCF, capex, shares, and segment operating profit reconcile in filing_facts and decision-grade proofs. Reinvestment ROI on AI GPUs versus foundry prepayments lacks a filing bridge; management_facts empty.

downside_control.rationale: Paying ~163x FY2025 owner cash ($549.86 / $3.37) leaves almost no margin of safety. Contract low ~$69/sh shows catastrophic equity de-rating risk if growth disappoints. Wonderful business at a terrible price.

return_vs_alternatives.rationale: Contract base annualized return about -22% and Lawrence synthesis -14.56% both destroy capital versus cash or other quality compounders. 15% hurdle entry ~$36 on contract base underscores how far spot is from owner-earnings value.

claims.claim: FY2025 continuing operating cash flow $6.49B less capital spending $0.97B implies about $3.37 free cash flow per share on roughly 1.64B diluted shares.
At $549.86, proof-backed component base value ~$96.45/sh implies deeply negative expected returns; primary 15% entry price on contract base is about $36.26.

strongest_counter_explanation: Owner cash is temporarily depressed by foundry prepayments and AI ramp investment; normalized mid-decade cash flow will justify today's price for a durable second-source AI franchise.
most_important_missing_fact: Normalized mid-cycle free cash flow per share after foundry prepayment normalization and MI350 gross-margin disclosure.
falsifiers: Trailing four-quarter free cash flow per share below $2.00
Net cash conversion remaining below 50% of net income for four quarters while buybacks continue
Data Center operating margin compressing for two consecutive years
specialist_findings: Buffett/Weschler: quality improving, price unacceptable. Reject. Reinvestment story cannot overcome ~160x owner cash. Wait for price or for filing-verified normalized cash power.
